faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIT Madras Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant recruitment is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant post at IIT Madras as per the released notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a PhD / M.Tech / M.Sc. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, Electronics, Telecom, AI or a related discipline, along with significant senior-level experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 300000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of candidates, followed by a test or interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Madras Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant recruitment must be submitted online through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant at IIT Madras is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum experience required for the Senior Technology & Cybersecurity Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to have a minimum of 20 years of senior-level experience in relevant fields like cybersecurity or technology management.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, or by visiting the official website of IIT Madras.
